items.title: [cross-repo] Generalize scaffold-provider contracts for polyglot Quint workspaces
items.reason: Verified remaining provider/catalog outcome from native body and owning plan; fresh complete empty native dependency snapshot does not clear producer publication or installed acceptance prerequisites.
items.remainingOutcome: After FS-GG/.github#3009 accepts the architecture and FS.GG.SDD#927 establishes the single Quint lifecycle, specify and implement an additive scaffold-provider/catalog contract version that describes provider identity, display metadata, source language, concrete product shape, typed parameters with prompts/defaults/enums/validation, external toolchain requirements, capability-command bindings, evidence outputs, supported platforms, and product-skill selection. Make identifier derivation provider-owned or declarative and ecosystem-neutral while retaining schema-v1 F# provider inspection and invocation during the compatibility window. Keep template transport opaque and continue to support dotnet-new/NuGet packages. Stamp exact effective metadata and tools into provenance, reject unsupported contracts and malformed parameters before invocation, preserve SDD-tree ownership/no-partial-state guarantees, and expose the contract to the Quint WorkspaceModel without embedding any TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, Go, or concrete provider ID in SDD code. Additional accepted scope: third-party provider-authoring SDK and reusable qualification harness, native comment5436166922.
items.nextAction: Implement and publish the ecosystem-neutral typed provider/catalog contract, provenance, third-party provider SDK and package-only qualification harness; delivered ADR-0092 remains the architecture input.

items.title: [cross-repo] Publish TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, and Go workspace-provider packs and skills
items.reason: Verified remaining provider/catalog outcome from native body and owning plan; fresh complete empty native dependency snapshot does not clear producer publication or installed acceptance prerequisites.
items.remainingOutcome: After FS.GG.SDD#928 and FS.GG.Governance#423 publish their compatible contracts, add concrete initial executable/CLI provider identities for TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, and Go with explicit language and shape metadata in the provider catalog. Share authored Node infrastructure between the TypeScript and JavaScript packs without collapsing their distinct output contracts. Pin every toolchain and dependency closure; ship lockfiles; provide deterministic build, lint, test, evidence, package, security, and release commands; bind the neutral governance capabilities; and scaffold directly onto the single Quint-backed lifecycle. TypeScript uses strict checking; JavaScript uses native ESM with declared JSDoc/checkJs posture; Rust declares toolchain/MSRV, fmt, Clippy, tests, package and safety policy; Go declares module path, formatting, vet/static analysis, tests/race posture, package and vulnerability policy. Author and manifest only the non-obvious operational product skills: node-workspace, typescript-project, javascript-project, node-testing, rust-workspace, rust-safety, go-workspace, and go-testing. Commands and invariants remain executable authority rather than prose inside skills.
items.nextAction: After exact SDD/Governance contracts publish, add and package-qualify TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust and Go providers and their operational skills; publish byte-identical artifacts to both feeds.
